name: rosetta-substitution-cipher
code:
use default
use IO.File

let plain_alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"
let cipher_alphabet = "QWERTYUIOPASDFGHJKLZXCVBNM"

substitute(text: string, from: string, to: string) -> string =>
    string(
        text
            |> map(c =>
                if char.is_upper(c) then
                    let i = from.index_of(c)
                    if i >= 0 then to[i] else c fi
                elif char.is_lower(c) then
                    let i = from.index_of(char.to_upper(c))
                    if i >= 0 then char.to_lower(to[i]) else c fi
                else
                    c
                fi)
            |> collect_array())

encrypt(text: string) -> string =>
    substitute(text, plain_alphabet, cipher_alphabet)

decrypt(text: string) -> string =>
    substitute(text, cipher_alphabet, plain_alphabet)

let source = File.read_all_text("plain.txt")

File.write_all_text("cipher.txt", encrypt(source))

let ciphertext = File.read_all_text("cipher.txt")
File.write_all_text("decrypted.txt", decrypt(ciphertext))

write_line("original:  {source}")
write_line("encrypted: {File.read_all_text("cipher.txt")}")
write_line("decrypted: {File.read_all_text("decrypted.txt")}")
write_line("round trip ok: {File.read_all_text("decrypted.txt") =~ source}")
